Descriptions.ShortDescription: Records imaging sessions and delivers detailed HTML reports (yield analysis, live stacks, metric charts) via email, Discord, or Pushover. Includes a built-in Live Dashboard and an optional cross-platform Companion app to browse your history from any device.
Descriptions.LongDescription:
[Full documentation](https://vorticose.github.io/nina.plugin.nightsummary/)

[Donate](https://ko-fi.com/sleepypuppy15)

Night Summary automatically records your astrophotography session as it runs and delivers a rich HTML report the moment your sequence completes. Reports include session overview stats, equipment profile, session event timeline (with optional multi-target altitude chart view), yield and imaging overhead analysis with per-category breakdown, per-target summaries with altitude charts, sky thumbnails, and rejected frame tracking, Live Stack integration, image quality metrics (HFR, FWHM, Eccentricity, guiding RMS, Median ADU), Target Scheduler integration with progress bars and Tonight's Preview, 35+ configurable metric charts with per-filter selector and event markers, and session history.

**Live Dashboard** - a built-in local web server to browse your full session history, lifetime statistics, and any past report from any device on your network, including an optional raw-image thumbnail gallery. An optional **Read-Only Mirror** serves a second, write-blocked dashboard for safe public sharing behind a reverse proxy or Tailscale Funnel.

**Companion app** - a standalone dashboard for Mac, Windows, and Linux that keeps its own synced copy of your sessions and serves the full dashboard independently, so you can browse even when the NINA machine is asleep or off. [Get it here](https://github.com/vorticose/nina.plugin.nightsummary/releases/latest).

Delivery: email (any SMTP provider), Discord webhooks, Pushover, and local save with NINA filename pattern variables.
